authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1577 indradhanuṣ explicitly gives Kalasha indr (oblique indrūna) and Torwali inhān rainbow. The Kalasha indru variants fit the contracted stem, while Torwali īnān has lost the h of inhān; the source vowel and nasalization marks remain intact. Exact survey form indrụ̄̃ is retained.
